_note: Pinned upstream sources for recalc_v1 (migration 053). `python3 -I scripts/recalc/recalc.py fetch` downloads them into the gitignored .cache/recalc/ and refuses any file whose SHA-256 differs; every later command re-hashes them. Raw files are untrusted data and are never committed (licences below): only derived values, with attribution.

indb_repo.license: No LICENSE file in the repo (GitHub API: none). The paper (Vijayakumar et al., Curr Dev Nutr 2024;8(7):103790, doi 10.1016/j.cdnut.2024.103790) is CC BY 4.0 and states 'All analysis codes and files are publicly and freely available on GitHub'. Attribute; commit derived values only.

ifct2017_npm.license: MIT for the packaging (Subhajit Sahu); the values are ICMR-NIN IFCT 2017 (Longvah et al.), NIN copyright, no open data licence stated. Already used by scripts/seed-ifct.ts via npm pack.

apjcn_2007.citation: Chiplonkar SA, Agte VV. Extent of error in estimating nutrient intakes from food tables versus laboratory estimates of cooked foods. Asia Pac J Clin Nutr 2007;16(2):227-239.
apjcn_2007.license: Journal copyright (HEC Press), free to read, no open licence. data/lab.csv transcribes its Appendix I numbers (facts) with this citation; the PDF is never committed. Download it by hand to audit lab.csv.
